notes.title: War of Kosovo: 2033 Beta 1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40354857/6107250b289f2f26a1781021d0ab93249d6d0c80.png
Beta 1.0.3 Patch Updates

- Presivy map has been redesigned and scaled to fit 5v5 perfectly

- Changes have been made to game mechanics 

- Fixed collision bugs on Presivy

- Added dynamic lightning

- Prizren map have been listed for remaster 

- Lag issues have been fixed

- Fixed lightning bugs

- Added new weapon sounds

- Fixed shadows performance usage

- Prizren map is now bigger to fit 32 players perfectly

- New widgets with animations

- Competitive mode added to the game
